digest.component_or_area: CI test infrastructure and pytest suite performance auditing
propositions: Comprehensive audit of all pytest phases >=1.0 seconds across three recent successful CI runs and local exhaustive macOS execution identified 501 unique phases with disposition recommendations.
No individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30 seconds in selected CI runs or exhaustive local census; measured maxima were 22.63s (CI show under write burst) and 15.62s (local default).

Gerrit 1817 merged change removes 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS/Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining in Ubuntu 3.13, yielding ~8s macOS and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without new job/setup/runner overhead.

All real Git/concurrency/partial-clone/process/platform/editor/identity/signing seams and external analyzers are retained as intended coverage; no equivalence-proven mock replacements were identified.

Mutation jobs consumed 53m42s runner-seconds (3222s aggregate) on run 31900214367 but completed before macOS critical path and add zero wall-clock overhead; no evidence supports removal without coverage loss.

Next approved implementation is songful-groovelike-horsemouse (test-only clocks/windows); pending research includes lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, and rival-ammoniacal-crustacean; no new shard/job increase is permitted per coercive-paediatric-bug.
